meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Intelligent refactor command. Triggers: refactor, refactoring, cleanup, restructure, extract, simplify, modernize.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重构代码结构，消除坏味道，提升可维护性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果代码变得难以维护，需要系统性地改善结构
copy.tagline_en: Restructure code, eliminate bad smells, and improve maintainability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase has become hard to maintain and needs systematic structural improvement

howto.what: 执行重构命令时，Claude 会先分析意图、建立代码地图、评估测试覆盖与风险，再制定分步计划，逐项用 LSP 和 AST-grep 精确改写，并在每一步之后运行测试和类型检查，确保不引入回归。
howto.when: 当用户提出“refactor”“cleanup”“simplify”等重构类请求，或指定某文件、符号、模块要求重构时触发。若请求过于模糊，会先反问具体目标。

say.text: 对 user 模块做一次安全策略的重构
say.note: 安全策略会先看测试覆盖，不足会暂停询问。

say.text: 提取所有用旧 API 的调用，改成新写法
say.note: 会先用 AST-grep 预览改动，再逐步替换。

howto.what_en: When running the refactor command, Claude first parses the intent, builds a code map, assesses test coverage and risk, then creates a step-by-step plan. It rewrites code precisely with LSP and AST-grep, and runs tests and type checks after each step to avoid regressions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says "refactor", "cleanup", "simplify", etc., or asks to restructure a specific file, symbol, or module. If the request is vague, it asks for the specific goal first.

say_en.text: Split AuthService in src/auth/handler.ts into two classes
say_en.note: It will locate usages first, then refactor step by step.

say_en.text: Run a safe-strategy refactor on the user module
say_en.note: It checks test coverage and pauses if too low.

say_en.text: Extract all calls using the deprecated API and replace them
say_en.note: It previews changes with AST-grep before replacing.
